messages:
deploy-bot: rollout started for runtime v2.4.0-canary across 3 AZs. image=redwood/runtime:2.4.0-kernelopt

incident-bot: paging: p95 latency > 1200ms on canary-group (20% of canary hosts) - alert id A-8493

sam: anyone seeing this? I can see p95 spike in grafana for canary-io-2

jess: yep, getting customer alerts too. 502s observed on streaming endpoints. stack traces show kernel fallback on some hosts.

mike: logs from host canary-03:
```
2026-02-18T14:02:11Z WARN kernel_selector: fallback to generic_kernel (reason=unsupported_quantized_op, model=redwood-llama-q4)
2026-02-18T14:02:12Z ERROR batching: drop_batch seq_len=2048 -> timeout
```

sam: looks like the quantized variant we shipped isn't compatible with newest kernel path; it's triggering fallback which kills throughput and increases latency.

jess: can we flip the flag `runtime.batching.v2_enabled` back to false? that's our kill-switch for the new batching path.

mike: doing it now.

mike: ```
# internal ff toggler
curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/toggle" -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"runtime.batching.v2_enabled","value":false}'
```

mike: flipped the flag on all canary hosts. monitoring...

sre-rotation: partial improvement on p95 but still elevated. batch queue depth seems to be backing up for seq_len>1024.

sam: suspect interaction between new batching coalescer and the kernel affinity change. If kernel selector keeps falling back we still pay CPU for fallback.

jess: recommended next step: rollback the canary to runtime:2.3.7 and stop the rollout. Can someone trigger a rollback? I don't want to risk full rollout.

mike: rolling back canary now via deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: target_image=redwood/runtime:2.3.7 scope=canary-group ids=[canary-01,canary-02,canary-03]

deploy-bot: rollback complete on canary-01, canary-02. canary-03 failed to drain: eviction timeout.

mike: manual SSH into canary-03, graceful drain + restart.

mike: canary-03 restarted and now on 2.3.7

incident-bot: alert resolved: p95 back to baseline on canary-group. root cause investigation ticket INC-3245 created.

jess: customer impact summary for SRE/Sales: ~4 customers reported higher latencies and 502s between 14:00-14:20 UTC. No data exfiltration. Support case IDs: #SR-8890, #SR-8892. Please escalate to AE if needed.

sam: adding mitigation notes: - disable batching.v2 flag for all clusters; - pin runtime to 2.3.7 on production until RCA. I'm going to open a rollback PR for release pipeline.

sre-rotation: leaving handoff for @marta. Marta, can you monitor post-rollback metrics for the next 2 hours and own RCA followups?

marta: on it. I'll coordinate with research to reproduce against model quantization variants and kernel selector logs.

jess: assign P1 and postmortem timeline: 90m initial writeup, 24h deep RCA.

marta: got it. adding notes to INC-3245 and linking perf traces.

sam: thanks all. closing thread. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: note: feature-flag change and rollback recorded in audit log ids: AUD-54321, AUD-54322
